files.description: Playwright tests for the AI page builder: page creation via the nav form, metadata editing with tab-order repositioning, manual widget add + inline rename, simulated AI widget generation (grid lock, transcript, READY reconcile, publish), the read-only presentation view, and confirmed page deletion.

testContext: Pages live in the nav's pages bar — expanded by default in a fresh context; the 'Pages' button is a collapse TOGGLE (clicking it first HIDES .nav-new-page). The nav 'New page' control is a plain form POST to /pages; pages_detail redirects widget-less pages to /pages/<id>/design. Design view (.page-design): #page-title, #page-subtitle, #page-tab-order, #page-show-title, #add-widget-button, #save-page-button, #delete-page-button, and the chat dialog with id 'conversation' (#conversation-message/-form/-status/-messages/-cancel). tab_order is a POSITION among nav pages — the server repositions/clamps out-of-range values (7 with 3 pages saves as 3), so round-trip a valid position. Save while idle POSTs /pages/<id>/update (204) then navigates to pages_detail (presentation if widgets exist, else back to design). Manual widget add renders a preview shell (.grid-stack-item with .widget-header/.widget-title span 'New Widget' capital W/.widget-title-input hidden/.widget-edit/.widget-delete); the pencil reveals the input, Enter commits, Save persists. AI generation (no API key in sandbox — simulate): intercept POST /pages/<id>/chat -> 202 {version_id} and GET /pages/<id>/versions/<vid>/status with version_status_payload shape {version_id,status,started_at,completed_at,error,messages,widgets}; keep 2 polls IN_PROGRESS then READY with a widgets array ({id,title,data_query,state,html,css,js,grid_x/y/w/h}) — the client renders them through the REAL /widgets/preview route (nothing persisted). Running phase: .page-design.is-generating, static grid, #add-widget-button disabled, #conversation-status visible. READY review: widget on grid (.grid-stack-item[gs-id=...]), Save enabled (publishes; intercept /versions/<vid>/publish -> 204), and #conversation-cancel DISABLED (cancel is only enabled while IN_PROGRESS or FAILED — the spec's 'Cancel would discard' applies to those phases). Unlike themes/automations there is NO page reload on settle — the grid reconciles in place. Presentation view (.page-presentation): grid has .grid-stack-static, widgets render .widget-frame iframes, no .widget-edit/.widget-delete; seeded published pages: 'Favorites Wall' (/pages/1), 'About' (/pages/2). Delete: #delete-page-button -> #global-confirm-dialog (message names the page title) -> hidden form POST -> redirect to /. Cleanup: POST /pages/<id>/delete.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/custom_pages.yaml after inspecting templates/pages/design.html, presentation.html, _grid.html, _widget.html, routes/pages.py, static/pages/grid.js, detail.js, static/nav.js (pages bar toggle), db/repositories/custom_page_repository.py (tab_order repositioning), and site_agents/serializers.py (version_status_payload). Iterations fixed: the Pages nav button is a collapse toggle, tab_order clamps to a position, the default widget title is 'New Widget', and Cancel is disabled on READY review. Validated with typecheck and a green run (6/6) against the isolated environment.
